scoring.match_rule: A brief item matches an expected finding if it cites >= min_citations_matched of required_citations AND its numeric key_facts fall within tolerance (exact match where no tolerance given).
scoring.rank_rule: rank_expectation 'top N' = the matched item must appear within the first N ranked items. reference_rank = position under the DAILY_BRIEF_SPEC.md section 5 reference scoring (informational; used for the rank-correlation metric in EVALS.md, not pass/fail)
scoring.merge_rule: One brief item may satisfy several expected findings (e.g. F5+F6 as a distress composite; F9 is standalone and must not merge) if it meets each one's citation and key_fact criteria
